_comment: Settings for cad_pick_place.py (CAD-part pick & place). World frame: table top at z=0, robot base at origin, meters.

inspection._comment: After lifting, the robot shows the part to a camera on the table. point = where the part's centre of mass is held; views = rotations about the vertical axis (yaw) and tilts towards/away from the camera (tilt > 0 shows the top, < 0 the bottom). Views the arm cannot reach are skipped.
